title: TAKE A NUMBER
sub: A museum of New York lines
riderLine: The clerk, the samples, the bouncer, the cutter, the elf, the bartender, the announcer. Every one of them skates, badly, in line.
description: A walkable gallery by NEW YORKERS by MLow: eight New York lines you can stand in. The DMV ticket machine that gives you a nine million number, the market line that only lets you leave backwards, the bouncer who freezes the line when you look at him, the deli ticket you can lose for fifty dollars, the drop line that moves only while you stand still, Santaland the loop, the bathroom stall that is occupied only while you look at it, and the front of the line at Grand Central where your number finally comes up.
og: Take a number. Nine million something. Now serving 4. Eight New York lines, one trick each, built by NEW YORKERS by MLow.
intro:
NEW YORKERS by MLow · A walkable museum of lines

TAKE A NUMBERA museum of New York lines. You take a ticket at the DMV in room one and carry it through every line the city stands in, until the board at Grand Central calls it. 8 lines, one trick in each, and everybody waiting has an eye flower for a head.

8LINES0EASTER EGGSNOW SERVING 40NEW YORKERS ON THE WALLS

The ticket machine gives you a real number, nine million something, and the board is on 4. The market line wraps the whole store: walk forward and the aisle walks with you, walk backwards and it lets go. The bouncer at the rope only lets the line move while you are not looking at him. The deli hands you a ticket at the door and a man by the pickles takes it when you pass; lose it and the cashier charges fifty. At the drop the line moves only while you stand still and the stock drops every ten seconds, with the resale table right there at ten times the price. Santaland is a maze whose exit sends you back to the entrance twice. The one stall at a bar on Avenue A is occupied while you look at it and vacant when you walk away. At Grand Central the departures board lists every line in the building, and if you kept the ticket and stand on the gold star under the clock, your number comes up.

SKATE MODE: every line is a skate spot, with three goals in each of the 8 lines, 24 goals in all. Ride as the clerk, the samples, the bouncer, the cutter, the drop clerk, the elf, the bartender or the announcer. K or the SKATE button switches any time.

Desktop: WASD to walk, mouse to look, click anything, V for the vertical clip of any line, M for sound, N for a line on the floor to the next door, [ and ] for the previous and next line, R for a random one, or pick one from the list. K to skate. Phone: left thumb walks, right thumb looks, tap anything, LINES for the list.
